name: create-ots-instance-with-vpc
description: Create OTS instance, table and bind to specified VPC
usecase: This example demonstrates how to create an OTS instance with a table and attach it to a VPC. It supports both creating new VPC/VSwitch or using existing ones.

inputs.name: instance_name
inputs.description: The name of the OTS instance to create

inputs.name: table_name
inputs.description: The name of the OTS table to create

inputs.name: primary_keys
inputs.description: List of primary key definitions for the table

inputs.name: create_vpc
inputs.description: Whether to create a new VPC and VSwitch

outputs.name: ots_instance_id
outputs.description: The ID of the created OTS instance

outputs.name: ots_table_name
outputs.description: The name of the created OTS table
